Officer's narrative
On a clear afternoon in Pasadena, Texas, Driver 1 was changing lanes on a multi-lane roadway when the vehicle's
right side made contact with the left side of Driver 2's vehicle, which was travelling alongside in the adjacent lane.
Both drivers stopped at the scene and remained with their vehicles. Driver 1 reported pain in the left knee, which I
found consistent with the direction and force of the sideswipe. Driver 2 stated that the lane change was made without
a signal and that the contact occurred as Driver 1 moved over. Two independent witnesses in nearby vehicles gave
statements that matched this account. Scene photographs show damage concentrated along the right side of Driver
1's vehicle and the left rear of Driver 2's vehicle, which fits the reported impact. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured
on the policy. Driver 1 said no prior damage had occurred to the vehicle, and no earlier damage was observed during
the inspection. A passenger was also in Driver 1's vehicle, but it is not fully clear from the statements which seat that
person occupied at the moment of impact. No ctiations were issued at the scene, and both parites were advised to
exchange insurance information before leaving.

- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.
